concept.title: Community groups and social activities
concept.shortdesc: Social, community and group activities where people meet, volunteer, join peer support, worship, read, sing, play music, do drama or enjoy general activities.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Attending religious services, worship meetings and faith-based groups, mainly Christian, and finding places of worship.
: Regular small groups that meet to read and discuss books, plus related writing groups where members share their own work.
: Help for someone to get out into their local community, find activities and services and take part in community life.
: Becoming a volunteer, member or fundraiser and contributing time and effort to a charity, club, event or local community.
: Joining in general community events, projects, groups and activities run locally for residents.
: Attending or joining a regular group where people with a shared situation or condition meet to give each other practical and emotional support.
: Groups, in person or online, where people with shared experiences support each other, including online forums and social media communities.
: Sessions of stories, nursery rhymes, songs and books, mostly for young children and families, such as library story time and Rhyme Time.
: Clubs and groups for children and young people running in school holidays, half terms and sometimes weekends or after school.
: Playing, learning or making music with instruments in bands, ensembles, circles and workshops.
: Gatherings and groups whose purpose is socialising, meeting new people, forming friendships and enjoying company.
: Informal group singing, including singing groups, sing-alongs and singing workshops, in person or online.
: Going to live performances, concerts, shows, screenings, discos and parties as an audience member or guest.
: Taking part in acting, musical theatre, drama workshops, rehearsals and productions, including backstage roles.
: General social activities and programmes offered to encourage social connection, enjoyment and a social life.
: Attending a regular monthly social meeting or meet-up for members, friendship and mutual support.
: Joining and attending general social groups, clubs and group sessions for company and activities.
: Taking part in an unspecified range or variety of activities, events or projects, with no single activity named.
